vintage: NSO Statistical Yearbook 2025 (2025 preliminary; some indicators are 2024 or earlier, and each figure shows its year)
gdp_vintage: Vietnam: NSO's national GDP 2025 at current prices (estimate); provinces and cities: NSO GRDP per person (2025 estimate) × average population 2025 (preliminary), which add up to 0.5% less

currency.note: VND converted at the World Bank official rate for 2024: 24,165 VND per USD (the World Bank has not yet published the 2025 rate, so 2025 figures use 2024's).

yields.label: Food
yields.description: Paddy rice harvested in 2025, in tonnes (NSO Statistical Yearbook 2025, preliminary). Rice is the food yield because it is Vietnam's staple and the one crop counted in every province.

yields.label: Production
yields.description: Employed workers aged 15 and over in 2025, counted where they live (NSO Labour Force Survey via the Statistical Yearbook 2025, preliminary). NSO does not publish workers by industry for each province.

yields.label: Gold
yields.description: Gross regional domestic product (GRDP) in 2025 at current prices (NSO estimate), converted at the World Bank official rate for 2024 (the 2025 rate is not yet published). NSO publishes GRDP per person; the total is per person × average population 2025.

yields.label: Science
yields.description: University students enrolled in the province's universities, 2023 (NSO Statistical Yearbook 2024; the 2025 yearbook publishes no university figures by province). Provinces without a university count zero.

yields.label: Culture
yields.description: Turnover of travel agencies and tour operators in 2025 (preliminary), in US dollars (NSO). It is the one tourism figure NSO publishes by province (Bắc Kạn's 2025 figure is blank); visitor counts are not published by province.

jobs_source: NSO PX-Web V02.42 (employed by industry, 2025 preliminary)
years_note: Each record's 'years' gives the year of its fields; cities (63 former provinces) carry 2024 HDI and FDI, provinces and the nation 2025 (NSO publishes those only for the 34 provinces since 2025).
